messages:
maya: Morning team — quick async sync for pipeline + security asks. What I did: sent VelocityCare SOW, ran demo yesterday, uploaded updated security appendix to GDrive (https://gdrive.company/SEC-VC-appendix). Blockers: security asked about customer-managed KMS and FIPS endpoints; need engineering confirmation. Today: follow up with VelocityCare and prep Dedicated network isolation one-pager. Ping @ryan for SOC2 artifacts.

ryan: Got it — I'll pull SOC2 summary + evidence pack. @priya can you confirm current KMS/HSM support matrix for Redwood Private? And ETA for HSM work? :thinking_face: 

priya: Hi — Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP KMS today. HSM integration is in progress, ETA ~2 weeks. I'll drop an on‑prem checklist and registry in #vendors later today. CC @sam-security for FIPS/encryption signoff.

sam-security: Quick note — if VelocityCare requires FIPS 140-2 validated endpoints, that becomes a blocker for Dedicated until HSM or FIPS-compliant endpoints are in place. Also need clarification on key ownership (customer vs Redwood) for contractual language. @maya what's their ask there?

maya: They want customer-managed keys and FIPS-level endpoints for their compliance team. For now we can promise customer-managed keys and flag FIPS as a pending item. I already noted HSM is in progress.

alex: Pipeline update: VelocityCare is at legal review. If security answers are green, close could be EOW. Also FYI — new inbound from NovaTherm interested in Dedicated burst capacity for batch inference (3k concurrent sessions). Will need engineering sizing. @eng-oncall / ops FYI.

sonia: Reviewed SOW — legal asked to remove the phrase "best-effort" from uptime. Can someone confirm exact SLA wording for Dedicated so I can update the doc? @maya

maya: Dedicated SLA baseline is 99.9% — I'll confirm exact bracketed wording with Product and update the SOW.

eng-bot: Deploy note: new doc 'private-kms-integration.md' published to docs repo by priya at 1912350200.

ryan: I'll attach SOC2 summary and a one-page KMS FAQ to the legal packet. If anyone has an on‑prem network diagram template, drop it here.

priya: Quick KMS config snippet (more in doc):
```
customer_kms: true
kms_provider: aws,gcp
hsm_support: planned
fips_endpoints: false
```
I'll flesh out details in the doc.

sam-security: Action: I'll prepare a FIPS impact note and recommended mitigations and share by EOD. If VelocityCare drives FIPS as a must-have, we should discuss expedited HSM prioritization or a contractual exception.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. Quick asks: @alex please nudge legal for fast-track review, include KMS FAQ + SOC2 pack. @sonia can you prep a customer-facing data flow slide? I'll follow up with VelocityCare on the FIPS requirement and schedule a short call if needed.

alex: On it — pinged legal (Claire) and asked to prioritize once we provide the docs.

sonia: Will draft the data flow slide and post for review in ~2 hours.

priya: Noted — I'll sync with infra to confirm HSM timeline and post an update here.

sam-security: Added security board issue #452 for FIPS evaluation and tracking.

maya: Anything else blocking folks? If not, I'll close the thread after updates come in.

ryan: No blockers from my side.

alex: :rocket:
